rationale: The run landed on the locale homepage (no product grid) and likely hit the EU cookie banner. We normalize to a stable PLP (men/outerwear/down-jackets), add a deterministic cookie-accept selector (OneTrust), broaden product link detection on PLP, and harden PDP price/title extraction. URL rules also prevent accidental hops to corporate domains or wrong locales.
code_hints: If #onetrust-accept-btn-handler is present, click it before any PLP wait.
If current URL matches the site root/home (no product grid), navigate to /en-de/men/outerwear/down-jackets/ as the PLP seed.
After reaching PLP, wait for at least one a[href$='.html'] inside the product grid, then scroll up to max_scrolls to load more.
When on PDP, if visible price selector fails, also read from meta[itemprop='price'] as a fallback.
